# Legendary Moto Rides

> Guided Royal Enfield motorcycle tours across India, the Himalayas, Rajasthan, and South India. Rider-led journeys planned in Delhi and guided on the road since 2009.

Legendary Moto Rides Pvt. Ltd. runs small-group and private motorcycle holidays. A website enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Routes, dates, prices, motorcycles, and inclusions are confirmed in a written proposal before travel.

## Tours

- [Motorcycle tours](https://legendarymotorides.com/motorcycle-tours): Guided journeys currently published for Ladakh, Rajasthan, and South India.
- [The Grand Ladakh Ride](https://legendarymotorides.com/motorcycle-tours/the-grand-ladakh-ride): 11 nights / 12 days on a Royal Enfield Himalayan through Ladakh, Nubra Valley, Pangong Lake, Hanle, and Umling La. Best time June to September.
- [Regal Rajasthan](https://legendarymotorides.com/motorcycle-tours/regal-rajasthan): Guided desert and palace-country ride. Request the current quote.
- [Stunning South India](https://legendarymotorides.com/motorcycle-tours/stunning-south-india): Guided tropical ride. Request the current quote.
- [Tour calendar](https://legendarymotorides.com/tour-calendar): Fixed departures by month.
- [Join a tour](https://legendarymotorides.com/join-tour): Request a place on a published departure. The team confirms availability before anything is booked.
- [Custom tours](https://legendarymotorides.com/custom-tours): Private itinerary enquiry for dates, group size, pace, and destination.

## Destinations

- [Destinations](https://legendarymotorides.com/destinations): Ladakh, Spiti Valley, Rajasthan, South India, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, Nepal, Bhutan, and Tibet.
- Mountain access, international borders, permits, and operating conditions can change. Availability is reconfirmed before a booking is accepted.

## Rider information

- [FAQ](https://legendarymotorides.com/faq): Motorcycles, experience, seasons, bookings, insurance, passengers, and permits.
- [Insights](https://legendarymotorides.com/insights): Preparation notes for Ladakh, packing, Royal Enfield riding, and a day on the road.
- [Gallery](https://legendarymotorides.com/gallery): Photographs from the roads, deserts, and high valleys.
- [About](https://legendarymotorides.com/about): The Delhi-based riding team.
- [Video testimonials](https://legendarymotorides.com/#video-testimonials): Rider films from Switzerland, Australia, and France on the YouTube channel.

## Policies

- [Terms and conditions](https://legendarymotorides.com/terms-and-conditions): A website summary. The written proposal for a specific tour is the controlling document.
- [Payment policy](https://legendarymotorides.com/payment-policy): Prices and payment methods come from the current written proposal or invoice.
- [Cancellation and refund](https://legendarymotorides.com/cancellation-and-refund): Deadlines depend on the terms issued for that departure.
- [Privacy policy](https://legendarymotorides.com/privacy-policy): How enquiry information is handled.
